tables.title: E20a. Practice levels against each other (wiosenna)
tables.measured: Both sides play the same best budget deck from one veteran collection per pair; 400 games per pair, both seats. Target: each level beats the one below it between 60 and 85%.

tables.title: E20b. Thinking time per level (wiosenna)
tables.measured: Milliseconds in Node on this machine, with other simulations running beside it, so an upper bound for a desktop; a phone is several times slower. Per round = plan and fight together.
columns: Median of the slowest round of a match
